title: A new workspace for BusLane
question: Compare the light and dark concepts. Expand either preview to inspect the full screen.

options.label: Light · Focused workspace
options.thesis: Bring the queue, message list and payload into one calm, continuous workspace.
options.viewport: A narrow tool rail and entity tree sit beside a message table and persistent right-hand inspector.
options.risk: Three panes need careful minimum widths on smaller laptops.

raised.raise: Every message uses consistent columns and a stable selection position.
Each work area has an unmistakable title and a predictable place.
Queue and dead-letter context stay visible at every decision.
Times and sequence numbers align for fast scanning.
Selection stays legible through tonal hierarchy without relying on color alone.

options.label: Dark · Dense workspace
options.thesis: Scan more messages at once, with a large payload inspector directly beneath the list.
options.viewport: A combined navigation sidebar opens into a wide message table above a horizontal payload and metadata inspector.
options.case: Strong developer familiarity and long-session comfort; lower ambient-light flexibility than the light concept.
options.risk: The horizontal inspector shows fewer message rows while open.
